subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should iOS onboarding add this dedicated Tailscale/MagicDNS connection path now, and should it be ported onto current main's branded onboarding/security flow rather than merged as-is?
rationale: The branch changes first-run gateway security UX and now conflicts with newer merged onboarding/security work, so automation cannot choose the product/security shape safely.

options.title: Port unique Tailscale path onto main
options.body: Rebase or rebuild the branch so the dedicated Tailscale/MagicDNS path lands on current main while preserving the newer onboarding typography and security guidance.

options.title: Narrow to copy/security guidance
options.body: Keep current main's setup flow and take only the raw-IP rejection/auth-copy parts if maintainers do not want another first-run path chooser.

options.title: Supersede with current onboarding work
options.body: Close or pause this branch if the newer onboarding/security PRs already cover enough of the intended product direction.

recommendation.title: Port unique Tailscale path onto main
recommendation.body: Rebase or rebuild the branch so the dedicated Tailscale/MagicDNS path lands on current main while preserving the newer onboarding typography and security guidance.

likelyOwner.reason: The most recent overlapping mobile security setup work makes this the closest current security-boundary decision owner from the history sampled.
